meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: Claude 会当主持人：把你选中的多个 git worktree、分支或 PR 拉进一个共享的只读聊天文件，分轮让它们各自说明改动、指出冲突，最后产出一份合并方案，并用大白话向你汇报。它自己不合并不提交。
howto.when: 当你有多个 worktree、分支或 PR 需要比对改动，想知道以哪个为目标、按什么顺序合并时。原文写明至少要有两个候选，只有一个或零个会提示你扩大范围并停止。

say.text: 开个 standup，把最近 24 小时有改动的 worktree 都叫进来
say.note: 它会先列出候选让你确认

say.text: 给这几个分支和这个 PR 开个 standup，告诉我该怎么合并
say.note: 按轮次收集各方说法，最后给出合并方案

say.text: 把 standup 的方案交给 /do 执行合并

howto.what_en: Claude acts as facilitator: it gathers your chosen worktrees, branches or PRs into one shared read-only room, runs rounds where each speaks, writes one consolidation plan, and explains it in plain language. It never merges itself.
howto.when_en: When you have several worktrees, branches or PRs to compare and want to know which becomes the target and in what order to merge. It needs at least two candidates; zero or one, it stops.

say_en.text: Run a standup with the worktrees active in the last 24 hours
say_en.note: It lists candidates first for you to confirm.

say_en.text: Open a standup for these branches and this PR, then tell me how to merge
say_en.note: It gathers each side in rounds, then writes one plan.

say_en.text: Hand the standup plan to /do to do the merges
